<thought>Based on the observed isotope pattern—a clear M+1 peak (~10 % of the base peak) indicating the presence of multiple carbon atoms, and an M+2 peak at roughly one‑third the intensity of the base peak, characteristic of chlorine’s 35Cl/37Cl isotopic distribution—I can definitively identify carbon and chlorine in the sample.</thought>
<final_answer>['C', 'Cl']</final_answer>
